messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High outbound embedding request rate detected for org=acme-inc (rate spike ~6x baseline). Suggested mitigation: rate-sculpt overlay and per-org concurrent caps.
priya_oncall: I'm on call. Observed burst from ~12 distinct IPs but same API token. Paging SRE + Eng.
sam_dev: Confirmed from logs: repeated identical payloads to /v1/embeddings with small text variations. KV cache hit ratio dropped. Looks like an automated scrape.
leah_sre: Recommend immediate live mitigations: 1) apply rate-sculpting overlay at edge to shape to baseline, 2) reduce per-org concurrent embeddings to 10, 3) disable embeddings-batch endpoint. Can do in next deploy window (1 min).
priya_oncall: Do it. Also check for credential stuffing signs. If it's token replay we might need to blacklist token and rotate. Jordan, heads-up for support comms.
sam_dev: Pushing overlay config now. Snippet: ```PATCH /ops/overlays/rate-sculpt
{ "scope":"edge", "rule":"embedding_inbound", "target_rate":"baseline*1.1", "burst":50 }```
ops_bot: Starting overlay deploy to edge cluster eu-west-1, us-east-1. Rollout 10% -> 100% with 30s steady windows.
priya_oncall: Also add WAF fingerprint block for 203.0.113.0/24 — matched repeated bad UA and header patterns. Leah, can you apply that?
leah_sre: Applying WAF block and concurrent cap now. WAF rule id `waf-embed-2026`. Also disabling embeddings-batch: `service.config.embeddings.batch_enabled=false`.
jordan_support: Noted. Two customers already reported increased latency. I'm collecting request IDs and will prep a short internal blurb. If collateral impact >5% we need a customer notice.
sam_dev: Implemented token-level circuit breaker: if single token >200r/s over 1m -> throttle to 10r/s + return 429 with Retry-After. Config: ```circuit_breaker { threshold:200s; fallback_rate:10s; response:429 }```
ops_bot: Overlay deploy complete: 100% rolled out. WAF rule active. Batch endpoint disabled.
leah_sre: Monitoring: pre-mitigation 5xx spike ~2.6%. 2 minutes after: 5xx down to 0.4%, tail latency improved. Blocked ~7k requests from 203.0.113.0/24. We saw ~4k requests hit the circuit-breaker.
priya_oncall: Looks good. Jordan, continue to assemble impacted customer list (by token). We'll keep throttles for 2 hours then evaluate rollback in stages.
jordan_support: Will produce list and short CS template. Heads-up: some customers on dedicated capacity may see QoS enforcement differences.
priya_oncall: Agreed. We're going to keep the batch disable for now to avoid re-amplification. After 30m stable, we'll test re-enable with stricter concurrency. Handing off to night oncall (tom_noc) at 23:00 if stable.
sam_dev: Leaving enhanced logging on for blocked tokens/IPs. If you need any quick queries: `select count(*) from edge_logs where path='/v1/embeddings' and status=429 group by token limit 100`.
leah_sre: Adding a short postmortem draft to /incidents/ -> root cause: automated scraper using valid tokens, mitigation: rate-sculpt overlay + WAF blacklist + circuit-breaker + batch endpoint disable.
priya_oncall: Thanks team. If anything regresses ping with `@oncall` and I'll re-open pager. :white_check_mark:
jordan_support: Copy. Preparing customer note draft now.
incident-bot: Incident closed for now: mitigations active, monitoring for 2h. Use /incident close to finalize once postmortem is posted.
